Each factor at 1 is positive and less than one. Mathlib's positive real one-sided residue already refutes the claimed equality; no missing complex continuation is assumed for that argument. The rational norm-2 factor changes residue 1 to 1/2. Keep the logarithmic-derivative normalization: -L_1'/L_1 = -zeta_K'/zeta_K - P_S'/P_S has residue 1, since the finite correction is analytic near 1. Correct the audit target and record the same upstream error for the maintainer; the missing continuation and boundary-continuity package stays missing. Confirmed as a baseline-note correction, with the existing strict GlobalNumberFields target remaining absent. Mathlib defines natural-number Dirichlet-character conductors and proves the rational cyclotomic field/character comparison. The comparison assumes a nonzero ambient cyclotomic level over Q, a coefficient commutative ring with enough roots of unity, the abelian Galois structure, and a nonzero divisor level m with the stated Galois/cyclotomic intermediate field. These are not a general number-field conductor modulus, its infinite component or a reciprocity comparison. Add conductor and mem_intermediateFieldEquivSubgroupChar_iff_conductor_dvd as related/special-case inputs and replace the blanket absence note. There is no need to widen the target merely to change its status.
